context: You found Lae'zel locked in a cage with two tieflings nearby deciding what to do with her, but in this variant those tieflings joined a random fight and were dragged far away from the recruitment scene. Instead of returning to argue or be confronted, they will leave the stage shouting lines like "I can't stay here," effectively exiting the scene. Lae'zel remains caged and must still be freed before she can be recruited; depending on who is present, companions have already voiced split opinions (e.g., Damays favors taking her back to camp, Nymessa wants to leave, Shadowheart warns not to trust gith). This dialogue covers an edge-case/fallback where the normal pick-a-side interaction or combat resolution did not run and the tieflings simply depart.
